skill.description: Read, search, create, and edit notes in an Obsidian vault while preserving links and structure.

memory.responsibility: Retain vault path plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform markdown notes into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through wiki links and tags while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose the minimum service operations required for the requested target; writes require an explicit preview gate.

stages: Confirm the intended vault and note scope
Search titles content links and tags
Create or edit the smallest note set
Verify files backlinks and rendered markdown

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
